title: Document Index
description: Index of documents included in an evidence pack, with pack-local artifact paths and content digests.

snapshot_id.description: Locktivity snapshot identifier for this captured document set.
snapshot_id.x-epack-summary: Locktivity's identifier for the snapshot this index was built from.

pipeline_id.description: Pipeline whose document selection was captured.
pipeline_id.x-epack-summary: The pipeline whose documents the snapshot captured.

run_key.description: Stable run identity used to make retries repeatable.
run_key.x-epack-summary: Identifies the run, so a retry of the run gets the same snapshot back.

digest.description: Server-provided digest of the captured snapshot manifest.
digest.x-epack-summary: Digest of the snapshot's manifest, as Locktivity recorded it.

captured_at.description: Timestamp when Locktivity captured the snapshot.
captured_at.x-epack-summary: When the snapshot of the library was captured.

documents.x-epack-summary: One entry for each document in the snapshot, including documents with no file yet.

document_id.x-epack-summary: Locktivity's identifier for the document. The document's files sit in a folder with this name.

name.x-epack-summary: The document's name in the library.

source.description: Where the document came from, such as an upload or connected source.
source.x-epack-summary: Where the document came from, such as an upload or a file linked from GitHub or Google Drive.

warnings.description: Document-specific warnings, such as a selected document with no file yet.
warnings.x-epack-summary: Notices about this document, such as that it has no file yet or that its text is incomplete.

version_number.x-epack-summary: The version of the document captured in this pack.
version_number.x-epack-method: Copies the document's version number from the snapshot. It is null when the snapshot has no version for the document.
version_number.x-epack-null: The snapshot did not identify a version of the document.

document_type.description: Typed metadata schema Locktivity recognized for this document.
document_type.x-epack-summary: The document's type, given as the schema ID of its metadata file, such as evidencepack/soc2-report@v1 for a SOC 2 report.
document_type.x-epack-null: Locktivity has not recognized a document type.

file.description: The document's shipped file. Absent when the collector could not download and verify the document's files. The collector result records why.
file.x-epack-summary: The document's file in the pack. For a linked document, this is the rendering of its source file.
file.x-epack-null: The document has no file in Locktivity yet.

source_file.description: The native source file when the shipped file is a rendering of a linked source. Absent when the collector could not download and verify the document's files.
source_file.x-epack-summary: The native file a linked document was rendered from, such as a Markdown file from GitHub.
source_file.x-epack-null: The shipped file is not a rendering of a linked source, or the document has no file yet.

text.description: The extracted text artifact. Absent when the collector could not download and verify the document's files.
text.x-epack-summary: The file of text extracted from the document, in chunks by page or by row.
text.x-epack-null: Locktivity has no extracted text for this version, or the document has no file yet.

metadata.description: The typed metadata artifact. Absent when the collector could not download and verify the document's files.
metadata.x-epack-summary: The file of typed details for the document, such as a SOC 2 report's auditor and period.
metadata.x-epack-null: Locktivity has no typed details for this document, or the document has no file yet.

path.description: Pack-local path to the staged document file, in the run's folder. That is artifacts/documents/ unless the run is configured under another name.
path.x-epack-summary: Where the file sits in the pack.

digest.x-epack-summary: SHA-256 digest of the file, checked against the snapshot's checksum.

content_type.description: Server-provided content type for the staged document file.
content_type.x-epack-summary: The file's content type, as Locktivity recorded it.

byte_size.description: Server-provided byte size for the staged document file.
byte_size.x-epack-summary: The file's size in bytes, as Locktivity recorded it.
byte_size.x-epack-method: Copies the file's size from the snapshot. A shipped file with no size in the snapshot gets the native file's size.

path.description: Pack-local path to the extracted text artifact, in the run's folder. That is artifacts/documents/ unless the run is configured under another name.
path.x-epack-summary: Where the text file sits in the pack.

digest.x-epack-summary: SHA-256 digest of the text file, checked against the snapshot's checksum.

path.description: Pack-local path to the typed metadata artifact, in the run's folder. That is artifacts/documents/ unless the run is configured under another name.
path.x-epack-summary: Where the metadata file sits in the pack.

SHA256Digest.description: SHA-256 digest of the staged artifact bytes.
